feature.unknownArm: 10..255: 原始码 N, preserving original byte N; not an asserted legal troop type
feature.zeroMeaning: This tool has no troop override attribute. No guarantee about the final person arm after other equipment changes.
feature.nativeUseConditions: Special arm2 checks current stored IQ>105; arm3 checks Force>105; arm9/8 have the same names without those special checks. Native giveTool hook can reject. No usability or conversion-success claim.
feature.nativeEquipmentOrder: GetArmType reads two slots; later nonzero overrides earlier value.

visualReview.reviewBoundary: Only pixels visible in the nine screenshots. Offscreen row mutations and scrolling independence use the separately captured full DOM/geometry data. Original custom tool fallback remains two columns. No real game, device or performance acceptance.

preview.boundary: Production fillDeepList and detail/highlight/group renderers only. Read-only explicit original-contract mock supplies stable 33 native tools, logical 200 people backed by 2000 physical slots, 38 cities, player king, current complete kind-4 menu DTO and incomplete five-property default goods DTO. Twelve rows include a long full name and equal names with distinct IDs. Fixture changes only two arm values 0→255 and 255→0 and then goods.custom, preserving menu owner and never clearing deepSig. PC and 844 mobile routes are goods-person0/赏赐; 667 mobile person-goods1/没收. Only private mobileHost isAvailable capability assignment is added. Lifecycle/configure/start/bind, actual bridge/LIB/WASM/storage/save/gameplay/physical devices are excluded.
preview.processBoundary: Exactly one owned Chrome context/profile and one private ephemeral allowlist HTTP server; only owned pages/context/server closed. No existing browser/game/CDP/8080/process inventory accessed.
